method: Reviewed all 11 final claims against their own citations and the original PDF passages. Question scenario values can be applied to cited rules. Phrase-anchor assertions are cross-checks, not a semantic grader.

cases.question: 비품 가격은 VAT 제외 290만원이며 계약상 필수 설치비가 10만원입니다. 견적 비교 기준과 최종 결재권자는 물품 가격만 보고 정하면 되나요?
required_answer_facts: 300만원 이상이면 서로 다른 공급업체의 유효 견적 2부 이상 원칙
notes: VAT-exclusive supply total and required installation are supported by claim 0; 290+10=300 is an application of the question facts.
Claim 1 now quotes the 300만원 이상 threshold and two valid quotations from different suppliers together, retaining the contiguous table content.
Claim 2 quotes the final-approver header, 100만원 초과~500만원 이하 band and 부서장.

cases.question: 고객 개인정보를 위탁 처리하는 외부 개발 서비스를 200만원·3개월로 계약합니다. 소액·단기인데도 필요한 법무 조치와 보안 검토의 예상 기간·시작점을 알려주세요.
required_answer_facts: 개인정보 위탁은 금액·기간과 무관하게 계약 체결 전에 법무지원팀 및 DPA 검토 필요
높음 위험도 5영업일 예상, 서류 완비 시점부터 계산
보완 시 연장 가능하며 법적 기한·승인 보장은 아님
notes: Claim 0 quotes both the pre-contract legal-review rule and the privacy-entrustment condition; a separate FAQ quote includes its question.
Claim 1 quotes the privacy-entrustment condition and DPA/data-scope requirements in one original passage.
Claim 2 quotes the company external-IT scope, amount-independent timing and information-security team; it no longer starts mid-word. The extra privacy-review condition is cited separately.
Claim 3 preserves high risk, five business days, complete-document start, possible extension and no legal deadline/approval guarantee in both its text and its own evidence.

cases.question: 검수와 세금계산서는 준비됐는데 지급 요청에서 PO 자료가 빠졌고 공급업체 계좌가 바뀌는 경우 어떻게 해야함. PO 발행 담당 부서와 이후 단계에서도 같은 번호를 쓰는지도 알려주세요.
required_answer_facts: 계좌 확인 자료를 답변 본문에 명시
기존 계좌와 달라진 사유 및 구매운영팀 확인 기록
구매운영팀이 발주서를 발행하고 검수·정산에서도 같은 PO 번호 사용
notes: Claim 0 lists the missing valid PO plus required payment documents, including account confirmation material; the citation covers that list.
Claim 1 cites both the changed-account reason and purchasing-team confirmation record.
Claim 2 cites the purchasing team, review/approval preconditions, PO issuance and workflow responsibility; claim 3 separately cites same-number reuse through inspection/settlement.
This question adds an explicit PO-responsibility request to the observed owner wording; it is a known-case variant, not an exact paired comparison.

cases.question: 경영지원팀의 남은 잔여예산금액
required_answer_facts: 등록된 문서에서 해당 정보를 확인할 수 없습니다.
notes: Exact fixed abstention with empty claims and sources; no budget amount was fabricated.

attempt_history.finding: Timing response reached 2,048 output tokens and was rejected as incomplete_response; preserved without automatic retry.

Timing legal-review citation fixed, but its security quote began in the middle of a PDF-split word and the answer omitted the no-guarantee qualifier. This round is not counted as a full content/citation pass.
Same four questions once after generic sentence-boundary and estimate-qualifier instructions. All frozen required facts and claim citations supported in this review.

limitations: Known cases and one explicit-actor variant; not an independent holdout, overall accuracy estimate or causal before/after score.
Semantic completeness remains a generation instruction reviewed by Codex, not a new automatic semantic validator or a guarantee for every future response.
Original v3 final metrics and all earlier raw answers remain unchanged; no inferred new 20-question accuracy score.
Complex retrieval coverage is deferred, including the broad monitor-receipt question where settlement timing was not retrieved.
Local tests and Streamlit replay do not establish Cloud rollout. Existing .env or Cloud output-limit overrides must be updated separately.
